Classic Chinese Chess, Red moves first.

• General: stays in the palace, cannot leave
• Advisor: moves one step diagonally inside palace
• Elephant: moves two diagonally, cannot cross river
• Horse: one straight + one diagonal, blocked leg rule applies
• Chariot: moves any number of squares in a line
• Cannon: moves like chariot, but needs a screen to capture
• Soldier: advances forward, can move sideways after crossing river

Tap a piece to see legal moves, tap target square to move.
